# Accessibility Checklist: Simplify the project pages to a four-part story

**Purpose**: Validate that the accessibility requirements for the redesigned project page and tightened project list are complete, clear and measurable (WCAG 2.2 AA, Constitution Principle X).
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. It tests the quality of the requirements, not the implementation.

## Colour and Non-Colour Signals

- [x] CHK001 Is the text contrast requirement stated for the yes, partly and no cell colours (text on cell background) in both light and dark themes, rather than only "existing comparison colours"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK002 Is the non-text contrast requirement (3:1) defined for cell and chosen-row boundaries or markers? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is "distinguishable without relying on colour alone" for the chosen option defined with a concrete non-colour cue? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified that the written answer text (yes, partly, no) is exposed to assistive technology and not hidden or replaced by an icon? [Completeness, Spec §US1-7]
- [x] CHK005 Is the case where a cell's written answer differs in capitalisation from its colour class addressed so the two cannot disagree? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Structure and Semantics

- [x] CHK006 Are heading-level requirements defined (page title, part headings, sub-headings inside a part) so the outline has no skipped levels? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Are table semantics required (header cells for option column and constraint columns, caption or accessible name)? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Is the requirement for the options table on a phone-width screen defined (reflow, scroll region, or stacking) without loss of header association, and without two-dimensional page scrolling? [Gap, WCAG 1.4.10]
- [x] CHK009 Are landmark and reading-order requirements defined for the heading, parts, side-by-side pictures and closing invitation? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the reading order of a picture beside its text specified so DOM order matches the visual order on wide and phone layouts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §US1-5]

## Pictures and Diagrams

- [x] CHK011 Is the written alternative text a required, schema-enforced field for every part picture, and is the description required for diagrams? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK012 Are requirements stated for decorative pictures (empty alternative text) versus informative ones? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 Is the requirement defined for the diagram description's placement and how it is exposed to screen readers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for image-load failure or missing picture, so the part still reads in full? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Reading Progress Bar and Motion

- [x] CHK015 Is the progress bar's accessibility treatment specified (hidden from assistive technology, or exposed as a progress role with a name and value)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK016 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for the progress bar and for the title carry-over transition from the list? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §US1-10]
- [x] CHK017 Is the "no animation on part headings" requirement testable and consistent with the reduced-motion handling elsewhere? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK018 Is the behaviour without JavaScript specified for the progress bar (absent without harming the page) separately from the story content? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Keyboard, Focus and Targets

- [x] CHK019 Are focus-visible and focus-not-obscured requirements defined for the Build links, the contact link, and the list theme filter, including against any fixed progress bar? [Gap, WCAG 2.4.11]
- [x] CHK020 Are target size requirements (24 by 24 CSS pixels minimum) specified for the tightened list rows and the theme filter once the spacing is reduced? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, WCAG 2.5.8]
- [x] CHK021 Is link text for the live version, source and invitation required to be descriptive out of context (not "click here")? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK022 Is the keyboard operability of the theme filter stated as unchanged and the unchanged requirement referenced? [Consistency, Spec §US4-1]

## Responsive, Text and Language

- [x] CHK023 Are zoom and text-resize requirements (200 percent text, 400 percent zoom reflow) stated for the side-by-side picture layout? [Gap, WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10]
- [x] CHK024 Is the breakpoint at which pictures move from beside to below defined measurably rather than "wide screen" and "phone"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005, §US1-5]
- [x] CHK025 Is the status and theme heading content specified as text (not colour-only badges) with sufficient contrast? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK026 Is the draft mark on the preview specified as accessible text rather than colour alone? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Verification Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are the automated accessibility checks required to cover the project page with a picture, a table and links present, and the list page including its empty state? [Coverage, Spec §SC-006, §US4-3]
- [x] CHK028 Is it clear which accessibility criteria automated checks cannot cover (reading order, meaningful alternative text, table reflow) and who reviews them on the preview? [Gap, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK029 Is the accessibility requirement consistent between the template's placeholder content and the real projects (placeholder alternative text, example table)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]
